Hi! My friend recently got a drawing from you and I loved it so much, I came to send a request as soon as I saw. I would love some art of my two characters:

[1] Willow .♀. 165 cm
She is a hitman. Although she acts kind, she has a secret mean streak and is bitter at the world. She hates herself and she hates other people, but she has to live because she is scared of death. She wants to become immortal.

[2] Alexei . ♂ . 188 cm
He is a rich man from a Russian gang. He is popular and likes to have fun. Even though he has many friends, he is secretive and has a hard time getting close to people. He is always smiling. When he was a child, he almost died and now doesn't view life as real.

They are married lovers who are very affectionate with each other. In public, they look like newlyweds who hold hands and feed each other and buy each other roses. An annoying lovey-dovey couple. They both like to play pretend around other people.

In private, Alexei wants Willow to hurt him. He is a masochist who thinks pain makes him more real and he wants to one day be killed by her because he wants his death to have meaning. Willow likes to feel in control and does not mind injuring Alexei.

Despite their weird behavior, they love each other very much.

Please draw them however is most fun for you!! Any clothes are fine. 

Some ideas:
- Romantic dates
- Something violent (Willow attacking Alexei)

Themes are blood, dancing, weapons, mafia, luxury, garden.

Thank you for your consideration!
